text:
kevin: FYI I'm about to land a Terraform change that moves ExternalSecrets' Vault path for payment-service from `secret/data/payments` -> `secret/data/redwood/payment-service`. PR: https://git.redwood/infradev/terraform/+/12345. Quick check: do our Helm overlays read the full path or a prefix? Also any KMS policy implications for the Vault role? I'll wait ~30m before merging.

olivia: Quick q — will this affect lease/TTL handling? ExternalSecrets controller resolves the full path; if we change path names the controller will treat them as new secrets (won't re-use existing leases). We should plan a short rotation window and add `refreshInterval` on the ExternalSecret. ping @maria for helm values.

maria: I checked the chart — values currently have `vault.prefix: payments` and templates build `path: secret/data/{{ .Values.vault.prefix }}`. If TF starts prepending `redwood/` we need to either:
- update `values.yaml` to `vault.prefix: redwood/payment-service` OR
- change template to `path: secret/data/redwood/{{ .Values.vault.prefix }}`

Proposed ExternalSecret snippet to keep for reference:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payment-creds
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-kv
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payment-creds
  data:
    - secretKey: DB_PASSWORD
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/{{ .Values.vault.prefix }}/db
```

sam: On KMS — we don't reference Vault KV paths in KMS key policy. The CMK is used for envelope encryption at rest and IAM principals for Vault server/role access. Unless Terraform changes the IAM principal ARN or the Vault role, KMS shouldn't need a change. If you do change principals, update this snippet in TF:
```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "vault" {
  description = "Vault CMK"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow",
        Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vault-server" },
        Action = "kms:Encrypt"
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

kevin: Thanks. In the PR I only moved the KV mount path variable (`vault_kv_mount = "redwood/payment-service"`) — no IAM changes. I'll add a `refreshInterval: 5m` and a short migration runbook. Will run a staging smoke after merge: `kubectl get externalsecret -n payments -o yaml | grep -A3 payment-creds` and watch for events.

ci-bot: Staging dry-run: ran controller template render -> 4 secrets would update, no template errors, no missing keys detected. Logs: `externalsecret/payment-creds sync ok`.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny helm-values PR to set `vault.prefix` to `redwood/payment-service` and add a migration job manifest that copies existing k/v to new path for a couple keys. Local test command:
```bash
kubectl -n payments run migrate-secrets --rm --image=bitnami/kubectl -- /bin/sh -c "for k in DB_PASSWORD API_KEY; do vault kv get -field=$k secret/data/payments/db | vault kv put secret/data/redwood/payment-service/db $k=-; done"
```

kevin: Great — holding merge until 12:30 PT. If no objections I will merge, watch staging for 10m, then promote canary. Ping here with any rollback notes.
